skills.name: MECE structure
skills.description: Buckets don't overlap and nothing major is missing

skills.name: Case-specific structure
skills.description: Structure fits this case, not a canned framework

skills.name: Structure depth
skills.description: Each bucket has concrete sub-points

skills.name: Clarifying questions
skills.description: Asks the few questions that matter

skills.name: Forming a hypothesis
skills.description: States a directional, evidence-based, testable, tentative hypothesis

skills.name: Updating a hypothesis
skills.description: Changes the hypothesis when data contradicts it, keeps it when data supports it

skills.name: Arithmetic
skills.description: Basic operations done correctly

skills.name: Zeros and units
skills.description: Zeros and units handled correctly

skills.name: Percentages
skills.description: Percent change, percent of, percentage points

skills.name: Growth
skills.description: Growth rates and compounding

skills.name: Math setup
skills.description: Chooses the right formula before calculating

skills.name: Sizing structure
skills.description: Builds a complete driver chain for an estimate

skills.name: Sizing assumptions
skills.description: Makes reasonable estimation assumptions

skills.name: Sanity checking
skills.description: Notices when a result is implausible

skills.name: Chart takeaway
skills.description: Finds the insight that matters

skills.name: Exhibit traps
skills.description: Catches units, axes and footnotes

skills.name: Data extraction
skills.description: Pulls the right number from dense data

skills.name: So what
skills.description: States what a finding means for the client

skills.name: Risks and next steps
skills.description: Names specific, relevant risks and next steps

skills.name: Idea volume
skills.description: Generates enough distinct ideas

skills.name: Idea structure
skills.description: Groups ideas into clear, non-overlapping categories

skills.name: Answer first
skills.description: Leads with a clear recommendation

skills.name: Supporting evidence
skills.description: Supports it with the right facts and numbers

skills.name: Complete recommendation
skills.description: Includes a risk and a next step

skills.name: Mid-case summary
skills.description: Summarizes progress accurately mid-case

skills.name: Concise delivery
skills.description: Says it briefly, conclusion first

skills.name: Driving next steps
skills.description: Proposes a logical next step without being prompted

skills.name: Data requests
skills.description: Asks for specific, prioritized data

skills.name: Handling pushback
skills.description: Holds when right, updates when wrong, uses evidence

mistake_tags.label: overlapping buckets
mistake_tags.reason_line: Two of your buckets overlapped.

mistake_tags.label: missing bucket
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your structure left out an area that could hold the answer.

mistake_tags.label: no structure
mistake_tags.reason_line: You went straight to an answer without laying out a structure first.

mistake_tags.label: generic framework
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your structure was a general template, not built for this client.

mistake_tags.label: irrelevant bucket
mistake_tags.reason_line: One of your buckets wouldn't change the answer.

mistake_tags.label: shallow structure
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your buckets had no concrete sub-points to check.

mistake_tags.label: low-value question
mistake_tags.reason_line: You asked a question whose answer wouldn't change your approach.

mistake_tags.label: missed key question
mistake_tags.reason_line: You didn't ask about something the case hinged on.

mistake_tags.label: too many questions
mistake_tags.reason_line: You asked more than three questions before laying out a structure.

mistake_tags.label: no hypothesis
mistake_tags.reason_line: You didn't name a likely cause.

mistake_tags.label: restated the facts
mistake_tags.reason_line: You restated the numbers instead of saying why they moved.

mistake_tags.label: shotgun hypotheses
mistake_tags.reason_line: You listed several possible causes without picking one to lead.

mistake_tags.label: overconfident hypothesis
mistake_tags.reason_line: You treated your first guess as settled before seeing the data.

mistake_tags.label: untestable hypothesis
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your hypothesis couldn't be confirmed or ruled out with data.

mistake_tags.label: ignored the facts
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your reasoning didn't use the case facts, or went against them.

mistake_tags.label: sticky hypothesis
mistake_tags.reason_line: You kept your first idea after the data ruled it out.

mistake_tags.label: dropped a supported hypothesis
mistake_tags.reason_line: You dropped an idea the new data actually supported.

mistake_tags.label: arithmetic error
mistake_tags.reason_line: You made an arithmetic slip.

mistake_tags.label: zeros error
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your answer was off by a factor of 10 or more.

mistake_tags.label: unit error
mistake_tags.reason_line: You mixed up units, such as monthly and yearly figures.

mistake_tags.label: wrong base
mistake_tags.reason_line: You calculated a percentage from the wrong starting number.

mistake_tags.label: percent vs percentage points
mistake_tags.reason_line: You mixed up percent and percentage points.

mistake_tags.label: growth error
mistake_tags.reason_line: You added growth rates instead of compounding them.

mistake_tags.label: wrong formula
mistake_tags.reason_line: You used the right numbers in the wrong formula.

mistake_tags.label: missing term
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your calculation left out a term.

mistake_tags.label: missing driver
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your estimate skipped a step in the chain.

mistake_tags.label: double counting
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your estimate counted the same thing twice.

mistake_tags.label: driver that doesn't belong
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your estimate included a driver that doesn't belong.

mistake_tags.label: unreasonable assumption
mistake_tags.reason_line: You used an assumption with no clear basis.

mistake_tags.label: accepted an implausible result
mistake_tags.reason_line: You kept a result a quick check would have shown was wrong.

mistake_tags.label: rejected a plausible result
mistake_tags.reason_line: You rejected a result that was actually reasonable.

mistake_tags.label: trivial takeaway
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your takeaway was true but didn't answer the question.

mistake_tags.label: misread trend
mistake_tags.reason_line: You misread what the chart showed.

mistake_tags.label: unsupported claim
mistake_tags.reason_line: You stated something the data doesn't show.

mistake_tags.label: missed units
mistake_tags.reason_line: You misread the chart's units.

mistake_tags.label: axis misread
mistake_tags.reason_line: You judged size from bars on an axis that doesn't start at zero.

mistake_tags.label: dual-axis misread
mistake_tags.reason_line: You read a series against the wrong axis.

mistake_tags.label: missed footnote
mistake_tags.reason_line: You missed a note that changes what the data means.

mistake_tags.label: read indexed values as absolute
mistake_tags.reason_line: You read indexed values as actual amounts.

mistake_tags.label: mismatched time periods
mistake_tags.reason_line: You compared figures from different time periods.

mistake_tags.label: wrong data point
mistake_tags.reason_line: You used a figure from the wrong row, column or year.

mistake_tags.label: no implication
mistake_tags.reason_line: You stated a finding without saying what it means for the client.

mistake_tags.label: implication off the objective
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your takeaway didn't connect to the client's question.

mistake_tags.label: generic risk
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your risk could apply to any company.

mistake_tags.label: missed key risk
mistake_tags.reason_line: You missed the risk this case turns on.

mistake_tags.label: too few ideas
mistake_tags.reason_line: You gave fewer than four ideas, or all from one area.

mistake_tags.label: unstructured ideas
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your ideas came as a flat list with no groups.

mistake_tags.label: overlapping idea groups
mistake_tags.reason_line: Some of your ideas covered the same ground.

mistake_tags.label: buried recommendation
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your recommendation came at the end instead of first.

mistake_tags.label: hedged recommendation
mistake_tags.reason_line: You didn't commit to a clear recommendation.

mistake_tags.label: unsupported recommendation
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your recommendation wasn't backed by your analysis.

mistake_tags.label: irrelevant facts
mistake_tags.reason_line: You supported your answer with a fact that doesn't bear on the decision.

mistake_tags.label: ignored the deciding fact
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your answer left out the fact that decides it.

mistake_tags.label: missing risk or next step
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your recommendation had no specific risk or next step.

mistake_tags.label: inaccurate summary
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your summary misstated what the analysis showed.

mistake_tags.label: rambling
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your answer was longer than it needed to be.

mistake_tags.label: over the word limit
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your answer went over the word limit.

mistake_tags.label: waited for the interviewer
mistake_tags.reason_line: You waited for the interviewer instead of proposing what to do next.

mistake_tags.label: illogical next step
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your next step didn't follow from where the case was.

mistake_tags.label: low-priority next step
mistake_tags.reason_line: You picked a next step that mattered less than another.

mistake_tags.label: vague data request
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your data request didn't name a specific measure.

mistake_tags.label: laundry list
mistake_tags.reason_line: You asked for a long list of data with no place to start.

mistake_tags.label: premature solution
mistake_tags.reason_line: You proposed a fix before finding the cause.

mistake_tags.label: caved to invalid pushback
mistake_tags.reason_line: You gave up a correct answer when challenged.

mistake_tags.label: ignored valid pushback
mistake_tags.reason_line: You held on to an answer after a valid challenge.

mistake_tags.label: no evidence in defense
mistake_tags.reason_line: You didn't back up your answer when challenged.

mistake_tags.label: dodged the question
mistake_tags.reason_line: You didn't answer the question you were asked.

mistake_tags.label: defense inconsistent with your answer
mistake_tags.reason_line: Your defense didn't match your earlier answer.
